mechanics: Ki Blast Super associated with Goku Black's instructor/skill set. The move executes a multi-hit sequence and can provide a power-up effect after its sequence; current player testing reports that the power-up can interact with/extend other active buffs. The effect is also reported to be sensitive to PC frame-rate behavior in some versions, so exact reliability, timing, and buff-duration behavior are not asserted as universal constants.
evidence_boundary: Numerical values and community-observed behavior are source-reported observations. Exact frames, universal scaling, hidden interactions, and reward probabilities are not asserted without direct evidence.
